capabilities: Chat with local LLM servers (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, AnythingLLM) with @note mentions, voice input and read-aloud
Create and modify workflows and agent skills with AI, run them in a visual node editor with event triggers and hotkeys
Index the vault with local embeddings for RAG search, including hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval and PDF extraction
Extend the model with vault function-calling tools and local stdio MCP servers with per-call approval
Encrypt notes with passwords and track AI-made changes with diff view and restore
disambiguation: Not just a chat client; it also bundles AI-generated workflow automation, RAG indexing, file encryption and AI edit history.
extras: Recommended installation is via BRAT as a beta plugin. Cloud LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini) work through the OpenAI-compatible framework, but cloud models need a local Ollama endpoint for RAG embeddings. Agent Plugin packages are pinned to a reviewed commit and validated before use; MCP tool calls require approval by default.
intentEvidence: This plugin is the local-only sibling of obsidian-gemini-helper.
motivation: The author built it for environments where cloud APIs are not an option, as a local counterpart for users who use Gemini Helper at home but need something for work.
problem: Cloud AI services are often blocked by security policies or unacceptable for privacy, so users need AI-powered vault automation that keeps all data on their own machine.

speech-popup (voice conversation), Dashboard Hub, Discussion Hub
OpenAI or Gemini key for cloud OpenAI-compatible endpoints

summary: Local AI chat client for Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM and AnythingLLM with AI-built workflow automation, local-embedding RAG, MCP tools and agent skills.
